mainInfo.label: Days A/P Payment Due after Go Live :

querystring.select: SELECT E.VENDOR_NAME AS SupplierHo, B.DESCR AS SuppCalc, D.DESCR AS SupplierClass, A.RESERVED_FIELD_5 AS BpkbAging, A.RESERVED_FIELD_6 AS DAP, C.DESCR AS MaxRefundType, A.RESERVED_FIELD_8 AS MaxRefundValue, A.VENDOR_PARENT_ID AS VendorParentId
querystring.from: FROM dbo.VENDOR A WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.VENDOR E WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.VENDOR_PARENT_ID = E.VENDOR_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.RESERVED_FIELD_3 = B.MASTER_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER C WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.RESERVED_FIELD_7 = C.MASTER_CODE LEFT JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER D WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.RESERVED_FIELD_4 = D.MASTER_CODE
querystring.where: WHERE A.MR_VENDOR_CLASS = N'BRANCH' AND A.MR_VENDOR_CATEGORY_CODE = N'SUPPLIER_BRANCH' AND A.VENDOR_ID = {0} AND B.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = N'SUPPLIER_UP_CALC_METHOD' AND C.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = N'MAX_REFUND_TYPE' AND D.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = N'SUPPLIER_CLASS'
